Trains to Redditch

This is the train I would look at for Midlands Air Festival. I would suggest Redditch as the most suitable station, at the end of the West Midlands Railway Cross City line from Birmingham New Street. From there, the Diamond 247 bus between Redditch and Evesham stops right by the Ragley Hall main entrance. Just bear in mind the 247 has no Sunday service and only three buses each way on a Saturday, so on a Sunday I would book a taxi from Redditch instead.
